title: Presentation property on a source open
statement: Let p:Y -> B and g:A -> B be scheme morphisms and U an open of Y. StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g U means: for every quasi-coherent O_U-module N flat over U -> Y -> B, StandardSingleFlatCounitPresentation (U -> Y -> B) N g holds. It does not assume U quasi-compact; the induction applies it only on quasi-compact opens. N is an arbitrary module on U, not the restriction of a fixed ambient module, so its further open restrictions can be used in gluing.
